phase1.instructions: Use only the tools returned by tools/list. Follow the installed phase-one production skills. Read the selected project and current content version before editing. Save native source through openmotion_edit_project; preview and export perform their required checks internally. Use openmotion_list_versions to find project snapshots and openmotion_restore_version to restore one as a new version while retaining later history. A transport cancellation does not prove a background export stopped. Report actual export state and accessible results; technical validation does not replace visual, audio and player review. Never guess a project from another conversation. Read skills locally or with resources/list and resources/read (openmotion://workflow/production/start, or the selected specialist); engine authoring guidance is openmotion://engine/SKILL.md and relative Markdown references under openmotion://engine/. For new work create explicitly; openmotion_open_preview never silently creates a project. Use openmotion_open_preview target=templates for the editor template library without any project/session/version binding; browse first and create only after user selection. Follow its page handoff, without a project record_display receipt. Persisted create/import/edit/restore/export/cancel and review requests require a stable requestId; preview action=open does not. Edits require projectId, expectedRevision and expectedVersionId. Query export progress through openmotion_get_project with projectId and exportJobId. Project list and version list are five per page; follow nextCursor. For template discovery, call openmotion_list_templates to obtain a local JSONL index path, then search that file with local tools. It does not return search results. Read candidate IDs with openmotion_get_template. Only an explicit request to use a selected editable template authorizes openmotion_create_project projectType=template; a recommendation request alone does not. Use the connected OpenMotion MCP tools for project operations and exports; a shell HTTP call is not an MCP tool invocation. Before opening a project, verify the connection dataDirectory and project/version with openmotion_get_project. Browser URLs and project IDs do not select another workspace. Compatible phase-one plugin/backend updates continue automatically on the existing connection through API protocol and Tool negotiation; keep the workspace, project binding and running exports. If the API is incompatible, update the incompatible components together when idle. Only an already-closed host transport or an internal legacy runtime replacement requires reconnection. Do not silently bypass MCP or change workspaces. After each content edit or restore, follow previewHandoff and production/native#continuing-edits to request the latest preview in the calling chat. Default foreground preserves the current chat: queue while inactive, then resolve the latest project version on return. Bind the actual native providerTabId, synchronize Codex IAB visibility without navigation, and independently verify settled visibility and changed live content. Record action=record_display only for the observed revision/version; queued alone is not confirmation or proof that the calling chat is inactive. Complete the same visibility checks for first delivery. Hidden automation tabs, markDeliverable and MP4 export do not satisfy editor delivery. Use visibility=queued only for confirmed inactive-chat deferral; otherwise report the hidden/unavailable panel as a display failure. Use presentation=now only for this turn's explicit show-now request; background skips presentation. Changed Tool descriptions and Skills require the host to refresh discovery before an existing chat can use them; API compatibility alone does not refresh its context. Verify actually loaded guidance, preserve data and project bindings, and report a stale chat without reinstalling or restarting unrelated work.
